# 科技发展：[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的进展 / Technological Development: Progress on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 观察站（前FTL观察）事件 pre-FTL observation event
- 来源 Sources：`events/observation_events.txt:4606-4667` · `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:563-575`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

五年一次的前FTL科技事件池 on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl_tech_events（权重 10/270，`00_on_actions.txt:563–575`）。条件：存在被我方“开放科技启蒙”（或被间谍行动盯上）的前FTL国家，其物种具有 “聪明”特质，且尚未设置 intelligent_learners_development 标志。/ Entry: the five-year pre-FTL tech pool (weight 10 of 270). Needs an observed country under open technological enlightenment whose species has trait_intelligent and no intelligent_learners_development flag.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**科技发展：[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的进展**：隐藏效果标记该国并给其科技情境 +384（相当于一次进度）；唯一选项仅作确认。/ Flags the country and changes its tech-progress situation by +384; the only option acknowledges.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

线性，单事件。/ Single event.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

触发依赖物种特质。/ Depends on a species trait.

- 已核对 Checked：脚本触发、效果与池权重。/ Trigger, effect and pool weight.
- 审阅改动 Changes：无结构改动（独立插曲）。/ No structural change; standalone interlude.
